bullets.text: grey sky makes every red thing louder. a mailbox, a scarf, one leaf that refuses to quit.
🪷 overcast at okunoin. the duck stood by a stone that tells termites to rest in peace. sacred and absurd, same moss.
relabeling the spice jars. paprika has been posing as cayenne for months and nobody at dinner said a word.
tuesday feels like a hallway. nothing wrong with it, just a lot of doors.
